about: A level-cap step, in a wild battle: the Hive Badge: the cap is 30 (GetLevelCap). A level-22 Snorlax, one point short of its next level, leads against a forced wild Geodude and switches out for a level-30 Tauros at the cap, also one point short, which knocks the Geodude out with Guillotine (taught in the battle, its accuracy roll forced). Both took part: Snorlax, under the cap, gains and grows to 23 -- past the old cap; Tauros, at the cap, gains nothing and no line says it did. A level-29 Ditto holding an Exp. Share, one point short too, takes its share without taking part and grows to 30: with the Tauros's nothing at 30, the cap is 30 exactly, where the two alone showed only a range. The battle has to end (gDiagBattleState 15, EXIT). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
